text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while eating with Symboli Rudolf…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah… That was delectable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see that she's folded her hamburger wrapper into a neat square. There isn't a single stain around her mouth either.
choice_data_list: Wow, you don't make a mess even when eating burgers.
Wow, you don't make a mess even when eating burgers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that unusual?
choice_data_list: It's usually not quite so pretty for the rest of us…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I point out that her table manners are impeccable when she eats, to which she replies…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… If you ever happen to meet any of my older siblings, you'll be even more surprised.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They are the very picture of etiquette. When I was little, I would always copy their behavior.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no. I have a younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …I had to act the part of the responsible older sister to avoid setting a poor example for her.
choice_data_list: I'm sure she's grown into a fine young lady.
I'm sure she's grown into a fine young lady.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, she's our pride and joy. Although, that isn't all…

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your New Year's resolution, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes, Father! I spoke to Brother and Sister about it and I've made my decision!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text: Oh, very good. Then, let us offer our prayers. First, bow your head…

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Look, a shrine maiden! Your clothes are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry! Listen, the shrine maiden is really busy right now. Let's not disturb her.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's quite all right. Besides, I remember speaking with you both last year as well. Would the two of you like to draw fortune slips after you've prayed?

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Ehehe, I can't believe you remember me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She was the type to disappear all of a sudden, then come back with a new friend in tow. Yes, that sunny smile of hers is wonderful, indeed. And yet…

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Big Sis! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There you are! What are you doing dancing with the lion dancers?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …She was often at the center of some ruckus. I think that's why I did my best to keep hold of her hand whenever we went out.
choice_data_list: She does sound like a handful…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, a handful and a troublemaker. But thanks to her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mom! The water went everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry for my daughter's behavior! I hope your clothes didn't get wet… O-oh dear, your shoes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. It's quite all right. You've got quite a lively little girl there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mom, I dropped my spoon too.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah… Why are you throwing things?! Please behave yourself…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hmm. Hey, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hippity-hop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do bunny ears do?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Flap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Flippity-flap! And bunny legs?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They certainly do. One more time?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now she can make a bunny with her hands too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, well, that's big sisters for you. I used every trick in the book to get my younger sister to behave.
choice_data_list: …I can tell you're a very caring sister.
…I can tell you're a very caring sister.
I bet you'd make a great mother too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, well, that's big sisters for you. I used every trick in the book to get my younger sister to behave.
choice_data_list: …I can tell you're a very caring sister.
…I can tell you're a very caring sister.
I bet you'd make a great mother too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I do understand that one must be strict when necessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …After all, there's nothing quite so cute as an innocent child.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mamma mia. Me? A mama?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …One day, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But they do say "spare the rod, spoil the child." If it were my own daughter, though—well, who knows?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf smiles warmly, perhaps with some of her juniors in mind.
